payload.description:
Implements LIM-877130. Begin with the two Gherkin scenarios on the parent story.

Scope:
- Compare immutable original and explicitly applied working draft using the local style profile.
- Report transparent quality dimensions and evidence-backed findings for factual-change risk, deleted claims, duplication, residual boilerplate, and unsupported claims.
- Calculate an advisory recommendation that requires configured net improvement and no increase in unsupported claims.
- Keep detector scores out of every input and output.

Definition of done:
- Both accept and reject behavior paths are executable and green.
- Verification never mutates drafts, applies edits, or publishes.
- The score weights and threshold are inspectable and documented.

Out of scope: provenance UI, telemetry, publishing, and automated patch generation.
payload.title: Luna: implement advisory revision verifier
